fact_text: The Pakistan Mercantile Exchange trades overnight, opening around 3:30 at night to follow global commodity markets in gold, silver, platinum, copper and oil.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: PMEX halts trading for one hour each day because it marks positions to market daily for risk management; without that requirement the exchange could trade 24 hours.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: PMEX has authorised about 50 to 60 brokers, who educate investors, onboard them and guide them through trading.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: Investors open an account with any PMEX-authorised broker or through the exchange website, much as they open a Pakistan Stock Exchange account, and the opening takes only minutes.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: PMEX clears and settles its own trades, so investors transfer money from their bank into a segregated account at PMEX and withdraw funds through PMEX.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: Trading runs on the MetaTrader 5 (MT5) platform, which PMEX provides and which investors can install on a phone or laptop.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: PMEX lists about 70 to 80 contracts, including commodities such as gold, silver and oil and international index futures.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: Gold made up nearly 50 percent of PMEX trading value as of 23 Oct 2025, the CEO said, reflecting strong investor interest in the metal.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: PMEX average daily trading value was about PKR 60 to 70 billion, the CEO said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: PMEX reached a peak single-day trading value of about PKR 177 billion, the CEO said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: For physical gold, PMEX buys from suppliers, tests purity, transports the metal securely, holds it in bank vaults and insures it at 100 percent of value.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: A physical gold holder can sell back on the exchange at any time, or request physical withdrawal once the position exceeds 10 tola.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: Most investors avoid physical delivery because of security concerns and sell on the exchange when the price suits them, the CEO said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: PMEX offers physical delivery for gold, while its silver futures are cash-settled and track international prices.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: Cash-settled gold and silver futures closely track international prices because arbitrageurs push local prices back into line when they diverge, leaving only a small spread.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: Local physical gold cannot match the London Metal Exchange price exactly because import duties and taxes add cost, yet local gold can sometimes be cheaper on local supply and demand.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: Illustration from the CEO: a 100 margin could control about 1,000 of gold depending on margin rules, so a 30 percent rise would add about 300 of gain.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: Leverage magnifies losses as well as gains, so the CEO advised sizing positions to what an investor can afford and bear in margin calls.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: The interviewer said local silver was quoted at about PKR 7,000 per tola, above the international-equivalent price, and may be sold at a premium or on the black market.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: Gold prices had risen by roughly 20 to 30 percent during 2025, as the interviewer cited.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: PMEX's mini tola contract is one-thousandth of a tola, designed for retail savers who want to invest small amounts in gold on a recurring basis.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: Brokers set their own fees on top of the exchange fee and vary widely, so investors should compare service quality, since higher-fee brokers may offer better service.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: Trading profit on the exchange is taxed only as capital gains, at 5 percent of the gain, the CEO explained.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: The CEO said Pakistan's population of about 250 million has very few commodity exchange investors, which he called a collective failure the exchange is working to fix.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: The CEO said Pakistan has only two exchanges, the Pakistan Stock Exchange and PMEX, and that any other entity offering commodity, currency, oil or gold trading is unlicensed.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: The CEO said online platforms advertised in Pakistan, naming Binance and OctaFX, are unregulated and unlicensed, leaving investors without a clear regulator or dispute recourse.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: The CEO said such foreign platforms require dollar accounts and outward transfers, which he argued drains foreign exchange from the country.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: PMEX futures let investors trade rupee-denominated exposure to US indices such as the Dow Jones, NASDAQ and S&P 500 without opening dollar accounts abroad, the CEO said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: Agriculture contributes about 20 percent of Pakistan's GDP, as stated in the interview.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: Farmers sold wheat at about PKR 50 to 51 per kg in March 2025, the interviewee said, against a much higher market price later in the year.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: Wheat was priced at about PKR 96 to 98 per kg in the market as of 23 Oct 2025, the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: Farmers are often exploited by middlemen when selling produce, which the CEO said a transparent exchange price could reduce.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: PMEX plans physically deliverable trade in six commodities, wheat, rice, maize, sugar, gram and later cotton, developed with the Punjab government over six to seven months.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: PMEX said its founding aim was to promote local commodity trade, which it had not fully achieved, so physical deliverable trade is its strategic focus.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: Digitising grain trade means aligning farmers, importers, exporters, processors, brokers, traders, millers, provincial food departments, banks for storage finance and crop insurers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: Nemat Collateral Management Company accredits private warehouses against international standards, checking management, weighing and grading equipment and staff training.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: Accredited warehouse capacity in Pakistan was about 3 to 4 lakh tonnes, the CEO said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: Pakistan needs about 25 to 30 million tonnes of storage by international benchmarks, the CEO said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: A farmer depositing wheat at an accredited warehouse receives an electronic warehouse receipt (EWR) integrated with PMEX, and can sell at the exchange price from there.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: PMEX is bringing banks on board to lend against commodities stored in accredited warehouses.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: PMEX aims for price discovery by thousands of investors trading billions of rupees daily, instead of a small group of traders setting the wheat price.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: A wheat pilot with the Punjab government issued EWRs against wheat stored in credited warehouses in the 2025 wheat season, and banks financed against them.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: PMEX plans to scale the EWR pilot and begin trading electronic warehouse receipts on the exchange, working closely with the Punjab government.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: Government wheat procurement was halted on IMF advice, and the interviewer said the IMF has since allowed government procurement for the 2026 wheat season.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: The Punjab government has not procured wheat for two years as of 23 Oct 2025; it once bought about 3 million tonnes a year, and with PASSCO about 5 to 6 million tonnes went unprocured.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: The CEO argued that a free market with price uncertainty pushes farmers to improve seed, fertiliser, water, harvesting and transport efficiency, which government procurement at a set price can blunt.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: Pakistan's wheat yield is about 28 to 30 maunds per acre, while leading producing countries reach over 80 to 100 maunds per acre, the CEO said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: After government stepped back from rice trade, a full rice marketing value chain developed, and the CEO put Pakistan's rice output at about USD 4 billion.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: The CEO acknowledged wheat is sensitive for food security because it is a major nutrition source, so government involvement in it is debated even though he favours market trade.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: PMEX is engaging a Shariah advisory firm to develop Shariah-compliant products, and believes its physical gold contract is largely compliant while some deliverable terms may be adjusted.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)

fact_text: The Pakistan Mercantile Exchange cited a peak single-day traded value of about PKR 177 billion, about half of it in gold, and an average daily volume of PKR 60-70 billion.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What All You Can Trade Through the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-23)
